mainEntity.name: How long does a typical pool renovation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a pool renovation depends on the project's complexity and the specific work being done. A basic replastering might take 1-2 weeks. More extensive renovations involving decking, equipment replacement, and added features can take 4-8 weeks, or even longer for significant structural changes or custom installations. Weather conditions and material availability can also influence the timeline. Our team provides a detailed schedule upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: A basic pool replastering takes 1-2 weeks. More extensive renovations, including decking and equipment, can take 4-8 weeks or longer, depending on scope and weather.
